## What problem does this solve?

Describe the behavior before and after, and link an issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. For runtime changes, include versions, hardware, numerical deltas and the measurement boundary. Mark checks not run.

- [ ] Historical evidence remains unchanged, or a separate new record explains the change.
- [ ] Public examples use synthetic or redistributable inputs.
- [ ] Relevant English and Chinese instructions describe the same behavior.

## Limits

State remaining assumptions and unsupported cases, if applicable.
